title: Bottles of Beer

scenario.title: Plural copy breaks at the edges
scenario.body: Write verse() first and test it directly, then check the whole song the way a shop checks "1 item left" and "No more items": 11, 21 and 101 stay plural, and nothing ever says 0 bottles. The property tests try dozens of numbers Hypothesis picks for you.

character.name: The Bottle Choir
character.role: who sing very, very long songs

tagline: Pick how many bottles are on the wall. The choir sings one verse per bottle, all the way down to none.

brain_blurbs.real: Counts down and sings each verse.

rules.test_usage: Explains itself when you ask for help
rules.test_bad_int: Refuses to sing for zero or fewer bottles
rules.test_float: Refuses 2.5 bottles (nobody has half a bottle)
rules.test_one: Sings the one-bottle song exactly right
rules.test_two: Sings the two-bottle song exactly right
rules.test_verse_last: The last verse says "1 bottle" and "No more"
rules.test_verse_two: Two bottles goes down to "1 bottle", not "1 bottles"
rules.test_counts_down_by_one: Any number: each verse goes down by exactly one
rules.test_never_says_1_bottles_or_0_bottles: Never sings "1 bottles" or "0 bottles", whatever the number
rules.test_sings_about_lemonade: Sings about lemonade when you ask, word for word
